newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: No upturn seen for quiet Singapore stock market.
newsitem.headline: No upturn seen for quiet Singapore stock market.

text.p: No upturn was seen for Singapore shares on Friday. Dealers expected a quiet end to a week which had seen the market drift without direction.
"The market is just not sparking any interest," said one broker with a Singapore institution.
The Straits Times Industrials Index ended Thursday almost unchanged, edging back 4.18 points to close at 2,043.71.
Dealers said the index's easing was caused by disinterest rather than dedicated selling.
"Things could pick up next week if we get some good news from the U.S.," another dealer said.
An absence of concrete domestic news was another factor adding to the Singapore market's uninspiring showing, dealers said.
